description: Use for the property tax on a flat or a house next year: the highest rate a municipality can set per m², before and after the Minister of Finance announcement. Tell the user the stage; an estimate is not an official value. The municipality sets its own rate up to this limit. Upper limits of the local property tax for the next year (finwire_property_tax_cap), per m² of a flat or house and for the other 8 categories of art. 5 ust. 1 of the local taxes act, from the formula in art. 20: this year limit x GUS CPI index for the first half-year, rounded up to full grosz. Stage: szacunek (estimate from monthly CPI, with 80% interval), wskaznik_gus (final figure from the GUS notice), obwieszczenie (announced by the Minister of Finance), obowiazuje (in force). Optional m2 gives the yearly maximum tax for a flat of that size. Municipalities set their own rates up to these limits; for this year limits use get_legal_limits with topic local-tax.

m2.description: Usable floor area of a flat or house in m² for the yearly maximum tax.
